defects.title: the scythe form has no source-rig truth

defects.title: the scythe sockets in SK_ME_WaveHarp_Skeleton are ~90-100x too far out
defects.detail: PIE read of the live instrument: Scythe_BladeStart/BladeMid/BladeTip/Scythe_Pommel sit 2.2-4.5 THOUSAND cm from the weapon origin, while the source authored them at (6.8,0,32), (26.5,0,36), (43.5,0,17.5), (1.5,0,-40.5) cm. Consequences: the scythe melee trace (PerformSwipeTraceShot_Local between Scythe_BladeStart and Scythe_BladeTip) sweeps a ~42 m arc and can essentially never connect, and the ScytheRibbon procedural mesh is a 42 m ribbon. Structural cause: the scythe form is a MORPH, so static skeleton sockets cannot follow the blade at all - the trace has to come from the morphed geometry, or the scythe needs a bone-driven rig.
defects.fix_class: new work - scythe geometry + a morph-aware trace; part of the Form 2 rebuild

deeper_finding.statement: the hold offset is composed in WORLD space: InHand = BowGrip * Mesh->GetSocketTransform(InstrumentSocket). A world-fixed grip offset therefore drifts as the character turns and can only be right at one heading - even though the property comment claims the instruments 'follow the hand and arm instead of the world'.
deeper_finding.consequence: a data-only fix can only be correct at the heading it was measured at; a heading-independent hold needs the grip composed in the character's frame.

runtime_change.effect_when_true: InHand = BowGrip * GetSocketTransform(InstrumentSocket, RTS_Relative) * Mesh->GetComponentTransform()  -> the grip offset is applied in the body's frame, so the hold stays locked to her hand and arm
runtime_change.state: COMPILED - closed-editor BS_GodFileEditor Win64 Development, Result: Succeeded (70.6 s, 2026-10-21 20:0x local). UE 5.8 API notes: the transform-space enum is ERelativeTransformSpace with RTS_Component (there is no RTS_Relative in 5.8).
runtime_change.risk: enabling the flag changes the MEANING of BowGrip, so the data override must be re-solved in character space in the same pass; the flag default keeps the shipped behaviour intact until then

blade_rework.blade: re-forged on an ARC instead of a Bezier: the spine is a circular arc whose centre sits down/back of the root (offset -10, 0, -24 cm), 104 deg sweep, 2.8 cm root -> 0.35 cm tip, 0.6 cm solid, PLUS a gold root collar (an eye in the blade's own plane and a short neck back to the head). The blade now reads as a naginata crescent, and its arc IS the melee sweep plane, so the trace and the VFX can agree (closes D8).

a validation pass that re-reads the exported file and asserts all of the above
a bake manifest: the file, the stats, the slots, the sockets, and the exact import settings

sockets_are_local_offsets.why: Blender's FBX ARMATURE export is unit-path-unsafe in UE: MEASURED, the importer applies an extra x100 to the bones while the mesh is converted by the unit path, so a skeleton import lands the sockets 100x out (or 1/100x with a different global_scale). Rather than fight it, the wand ships as a STATIC mesh and the sockets are LOCAL OFFSETS authored by the forge.
sockets_are_local_offsets.runtime_use: the component carries these as FVector properties; the melee trace is the weapon's world transform x the offset, so the trace provably follows the blade's forged arc (closes D8).

lessons: Blender FBX armature -> UE: the bone path is not unit-safe (extra x100 measured). Export static and carry the sockets as offsets.
UE's STATIC FBX import creates ONE mesh per FBX node - 'combine_meshes' does not combine static meshes. JOIN the parts on the export side.
Export with mesh_smooth_type='FACE' or UE warns 'No smoothing group information'.
The FBX importer creates duplicate MI_* instances when the canonical material lives in another folder - point the slots at the originals and delete the copies.
Monolith's HTTP responses can be DROPPED (socket_send_failure) - a silent call may still have succeeded. Verify with the asset registry, not the response body.
ue_import.incident: during the cleanup an incomplete keep-list DELETED the shipped SK_ME_WaveHarp_Scythe and SK_ME_WaveHarp_Skeleton. Both were restored immediately from git (15.83 MB and 0.02 MB, verified) and the tree is clean. Lesson: enumerate the folder and allow-list EVERY shipped asset before any bulk delete; a missing entry in a keep-list is a deletion.
